args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing
deeply nested arrays. Affected <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The 2.x fix landed in 2.9.4, so we stay on the 2.x line rather than jumping to 3.x.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (sha c8b8ab7878): **passed**

## Review
Requesting review from @alex. Merge requires code-owner approval per policy.
